title: Vignette 2026-10-30: the first iteration of a registry, lock down only the smallest piece

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30, on the RFC-049 Open Questions: "lets properly compare these options. We should make a decision only when we know what the options really are and the pros and cons. If possible our decision should state why we chose a path."

"Again, present me with options and a rationale. What are the trade-offs for each path?"

"I need to decide these properly. Lets work through what we are building.   We are creating the first iteration of a registry, and want to only lock down the smallest piece now, and then gradually refine as we use the system and learn."

sections.label: Source
